Response: [{'id': 0, 'distance': 0.9128709}, {'id': 1, 'distance': 0.9128709}, {'id': 2, 'distance': 0.9128709}, {'id': 3, 'distance': 0.9128709}, {'id': 4, 'distance': 0.9128709}] - all with identical vectors.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: python -c "from pymilvus import MilvusClient; client = MilvusClient('http://localhost:19530'); client.create_collection('test_gv', dimension=4); client.insert('test_gv', [{'id': i, 'vector': [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]} for i in range(10)]); client.load_collection('test_gv'); result = client.search('test_gv', data=[[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5]], limit=5, group_params={'groupByField': 'vector', 'groupSize': 1}); print('Result:', result)"

verdicts.rationale: Milvus 038声称分组参数(groupParams)无效,但根本原因是API contract不匹配。源码显示REST v2 handler期望GroupByField字段位于顶层(JSON标签'groupingField'),但raw request使用嵌套'groupParams: {groupByField, groupSize}'结构。handler_v2.go无代码提取groupParams内参数,导致分组参数被忽略,搜索返回未分组结果。这是参数传递方式错误(mundane_api_semantics)非分组算法缺陷。若使用正确的顶层字段结构,分组逻辑可能正常工作。
